_note: Two kinds of preset live here and they behave very differently.
IDENTITY presets (kind='rvc') are speaker-locked: a trained decoder renders
your speech in a fixed target voice, so the output sounds like the SAME
person no matter who talks into the mic. These require a model file.
CHARACTER presets (kind='dsp') are relative transforms of YOUR voice using
independent pitch + formant shifting. They need no download and no GPU, but
two different speakers using 'Deep Male' will still sound like two people.
No third-party voice checkpoints are bundled or auto-downloaded. Point
remote_catalog_url at your own catalog, or drop .pth/.index files into the
models folder and VoxMorph will discover them automatically.

presets.name: Natural (bypass)
presets.description: Cleanup only - denoise, gate, EQ and limiting. No voice change.

presets.name: Deep Male
presets.description: Lower pitch with a larger vocal tract. Authoritative, not muddy.

presets.name: Giant
presets.description: Very large vocal tract with subharmonic weight.

presets.name: Radio Host
presets.description: Broadcast chain: slight depth, heavy compression, presence lift.

presets.name: Young Female
presets.description: Higher pitch with a smaller vocal tract - avoids chipmunk artefacts.

presets.name: Soft Female
presets.description: Gentler lift with breathier top end.

presets.name: Kid
presets.description: Small vocal tract, bright and quick.

presets.name: Alien
presets.description: Inharmonic ring modulation over a narrow band.

presets.name: Chipmunk
presets.description: Deliberately unnatural - pitch up without formant correction.
